source.timeframeNotes: clean deploy-free/incident-free k6 window (25m33s). Co-tenant astronomy-shop / honcho / memos / flagd entries excluded by service scope; front-end discovery resolved crewai-deepseek-agent/request (301 root spans) unambiguously. CoV on the two partial boundary minutes is an edge artifact (0.166); true interior arrival is steady (0.016).
queries: fetch spans | filter request.is_root_span==true | sort start_time asc | summarize takeFirst(service.name),takeFirst(span.name) by trace.id | summarize count() by entryService,entryOp  (G1-C front-end discovery -> crewai-deepseek-agent/request, 301 traces)
fetch logs | filter k8s.container.name=='istio-proxy' | summarize count()  (access-log availability probe -> 0 lines => spans-only)

fetch spans | filter is_root_span && service.name=='crewai-deepseek-agent' && span.name=='crewai-deepseek-agent/request' | join [spans|filter span.name=='execute_tool'|summarize count() by trace.id] leftOuter on trace.id | summarize count() by archetype  (behavioral split: Agentic 96 / Conversational 205)

fetch spans | filter span.name=='execute_tool' | summarize n=count() by trace.id | limit 1 | join [spans] inner on trace.id | sort start_time asc  (JOURNEY STEP RECONSTRUCTION from the trace span-tree, both archetypes)

fetch spans | filter span.name=='agent.turn' && service.name=='crewai-deepseek-agent' | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),avg(duration),sum(duration),count()  (per-turn baseline + Little's Law busy-time integral)
fetch spans | filter span.name=='execute_tool' | summarize count() by tool.name  (tools observed: web_search 141, calculator 38)
fetch spans | filter is_root_span && service.name=='crewai-deepseek-agent' | summarize count() by bin(start_time,1m) | summarize avg,stddev  (G3-B CoV: interior 0.016 steady)

journeys.description: Conversational — pure-LLM turn (no tool call). Reconstructed from the trace span-tree: crewai-deepseek-agent/request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> finalize -> message.sent. One HTTP driver step (POST /request); the internal span tree runs server-side within that request. Terminal signal = execute_tool (absent).

Agentic — tool-using turn (ReAct loop: execute_tool). Reconstructed from the trace span-tree: crewai-deepseek-agent/request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> execute_tool(web_search|calculator) -> Tool Usage -> llm.call -> chat -> (ReAct loop) -> finalize -> message.sent. One HTTP driver step (POST /request); the internal span tree runs server-side within that request. Terminal signal = execute_tool (present).
